summary: This clinical trial compares two different study drugs, maridebart cafraglutide and semaglutide, in adults with type 2 diabetes. Type 2 diabetes is a condition where the body does not use insulin properly, leading to high levels of sugar in the blood. Participants in this Phase 3 trial are already taking metformin, a common medication used to lower blood sugar. Amgen is sponsoring the study to enroll 1300 participants, and the status is currently Recruiting.
